info.title: Aura Historia Partner Product API Reference
info.description: Generated subset of the Aura Historia OpenAPI specification containing only the partner product batch endpoints and the components they require.

put.description:
Creates new products or updates existing ones for a shop in a single batch call,
using bearer authentication. This endpoint is intended for partner shops and accepts:
- a Cognito bearer token for the partner user linked to the shop, or
- an Aura Historia access token owned by that partner user.

Aura Historia access tokens on this endpoint must include the `products:write` scope.

The request body is an array of `PutProductData` objects. Each entry is forwarded
individually to the asynchronous partner-product ingestion queue as an upsert command.
When the queued command is later ingested:
- **New product** — a full product is created using all provided fields. Omitting
  `title`, `url`, or `state` causes the backend to fall back to an empty title,
  a placeholder URL, and `LISTED` respectively.
- **Existing product** — the backend applies `price`, `priceEstimateMin`,
  `priceEstimateMax`, `state`, `url`, `images`, `auctionStart`, and `auctionEnd`.
  `title`, `description`, `sellerName`, `structuredAddress`, and `geoAddress`
  are ignored on the update path.
- On the update path, omitting or sending `null` for `price`, `priceEstimateMin`,
  `priceEstimateMax`, `url`, `auctionStart`, or `auctionEnd` leaves the stored value
  unchanged.
- On the update path, `images` always replaces the stored image set; omitting
  `images` or sending `null` is treated as an empty list and therefore clears all
  stored images.

The response returns HTTP 202 with an array containing only the `shopsProductId` values
that failed to be forwarded to the queue. An empty array indicates that all upserts were
accepted for asynchronous processing.

parameters.name: shopId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the partner shop

requestBody.description: Array of products to upsert. Must not be empty.

description.text: A beautiful 18th-century baroque violin in excellent condition.

update_existing.summary: Update an existing product while leaving the current price unchanged

202.description:
Batch upsert request accepted for asynchronous processing. Returns an array containing
the `shopsProductId` values that failed to be forwarded to the ingestion queue.
An empty array means all upserts were accepted.

all_accepted.summary: All upserts accepted for asynchronous processing

partial_failure.summary: Some products failed to be forwarded to the queue

post.description:
Creates one or more products for a shop using bearer authentication.
This endpoint is intended for partner shops and accepts:
- a Cognito bearer token for the partner user linked to the shop, or
- an Aura Historia access token owned by that partner user.

Aura Historia access tokens on this endpoint must include the `products:write` scope.

The request body is an array of `PostProductData` objects. Each entry is forwarded
individually to the asynchronous partner-product ingestion queue.

The response returns HTTP 202 with an array containing only the `shopsProductId` values
that failed to be forwarded to the queue. An empty array indicates that all products were
accepted for asynchronous processing.

patch.description:
Updates one or more existing products for a shop using bearer authentication.
This endpoint is intended for partner shops and accepts:
- a Cognito bearer token for the partner user linked to the shop, or
- an Aura Historia access token owned by that partner user.

Aura Historia access tokens on this endpoint must include the `products:write` scope.

The request body is an array of `PatchProductData` objects. Only the fields provided in
each entry are updated; omitted optional fields are left unchanged. Each entry is forwarded
individually to the asynchronous partner-product ingestion queue.

The response returns HTTP 202 with an array containing only the `shopsProductId` values
that failed to be forwarded to the queue. An empty array indicates that all updates were
accepted for asynchronous processing. Because persistence happens asynchronously, acceptance
does not guarantee that the referenced product currently exists or that the update will
later succeed.

parameters.name: shopId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the partner shop

requestBody.description: Array of product updates to apply. Must not be empty.

202.description:
Batch update request accepted for asynchronous processing. Returns an array containing
the `shopsProductId` values that failed to be forwarded to the ingestion queue.
An empty array means all updates were accepted.

all_accepted.summary: All updates accepted for asynchronous processing

partial_failure.summary: Some products failed to be forwarded to the queue

BearerAuth.description:
Cognito JWT bearer token.
This scheme is used for authenticated user routes and for partner routes that accept Cognito user tokens.

AccessTokenAuth.description:
Aura Historia bearer access token created through `/api/v1/me/access-tokens`.
Tokens are sent as standard bearer authorization headers.
Selected partner routes accept this scheme instead of the removed partner API-key flow.

oneOf.description: UUID of the user who performed the change.

ActorData.description:
Audit actor encoded as a plain string.
Values are either the literal `SYSTEM` or the UUID of the acting user.

productSlugId.description:

Format: {product-title}-{6-char-hex} where the title is derived from the product name.
Example: "amazing-product-fa87c4"

Human-readable slug identifier of the shop (kebab-case, derived from shop name).

sellerName.description: Display name of the seller associated with the product

Optional structured address propagated from the selling shop when available.
This is the address that backs the product's geo-search filters.

geoAddress.description:

price.description:

url.description: Raw URL to the product on the shop's website.

viewUrl.description: Tracked or affiliate URL generated by the backend for user-facing navigation to the product.

PersonalizedGetProductData.description:
Wrapper for product data with optional user-specific state.
When user is authenticated, includes personalized information such as watchlist status.
When user is anonymous, only the product data is present.

userState.description: Optional user-specific state for this product (only present when authenticated)

PersonalizedGetProductSummaryData.description:
Wrapper for lightweight product summary data with optional user-specific state.
Used in search results and similar products listings.
When user is authenticated, includes personalized information such as watchlist status.
When user is anonymous, only the product summary data is present.

userState.description: Optional user-specific state for this product (only present when authenticated)

PersonalizedProductSearchResultData.description:
Paginated collection of personalized products using cursor-based pagination (search-after pattern).
Each product may include user-specific state when the request is authenticated.

items.description: Array of personalized product summaries in the current page

size.description: Number of products returned in the current page

total.description: Total number of products matching the query (optional, may not always be available)

searchAfter.description:
Cursor for the next page (JSON value). Present when there are more results.
Pass this value as the `searchAfter` query parameter to get the next page.
This can be ANY heterogeneous array.

ProductUserStateData.description: User-specific state information for a product

WatchlistUserStateData.description: Watchlist-specific user state for a product

watching.description: Whether the product is on the user's watchlist

notifications.description: Whether notifications are enabled for this watchlist product

ProhibitedContentUserStateData.description:
User's consent state for viewing prohibited content on a product.
When `consent` is `true`, image URLs for images with prohibited content are included in the response.
When `consent` is `false`, image URLs for images with prohibited content are omitted.

consent.description: Whether the user has consented to view prohibited content

NotificationUserStateData.description:
User's notification seen-state for a product.
When `seen` is `false`, the product has at least one unseen notification for the authenticated user.
When `seen` is `true`, there are no unseen notifications (or no notifications at all) for the user on this product.
Defaults to `true`.
`originEventId` is present whenever at least one notification exists for the user on this product (regardless of `seen` status), and absent when there are no notifications.

seen.description: Whether the latest notification for this product has been seen by the user. Defaults to `true` when no notifications exist.

originEventId.description:
The ID of the domain event that triggered the latest notification for this product.
Present whenever at least one notification exists for the user on this product (seen or unseen).
Absent (`undefined` / omitted) when no notifications exist for this product.

SearchFilterUserStateData.description:
User's saved-search-filter match state for a product.
When `matched` is `true`, at least one of the user's saved search filters matched this product.
`userSearchFilterId`, `userSearchFilterName`, `matchReason`, and `matchFeedback` are only
present when `matched` is `true`.
Defaults to `matched: false` when the user has no saved search filters or none of them matched.
When `hidden` is `true`, the match exceeds the user's monthly search-filter match quota and the
product data is anonymized (nil IDs, placeholder title, unknown enums, nulled timestamps).
Only matches ranked beyond the quota (by ascending match creation time) are hidden;
the first N matches (where N is the user's tier quota) remain fully visible.

matched.description: Whether any of the user's saved search filters matched this product. Defaults to `false`.

hidden.description:
Whether this match is hidden because the user has exceeded their monthly search-filter match quota.
When `true`, the product data in the response is anonymized: the `productId` is set to a nil UUID,
the title becomes a language-specific placeholder, all other UUID
fields are nil, enum fields are set to their unknown variants, optional fields are omitted, and
timestamps are set to the Unix epoch.
Defaults to `false`.

userSearchFilterId.description:
The ID of the saved search filter that matched this product.
Present only when `matched` is `true`; omitted otherwise.

userSearchFilterName.description:
The user-defined name of the saved search filter that matched this product.
Present only when `matched` is `true`; omitted otherwise.

matchReason.description:
A human-readable explanation of why the saved search filter matched this product.
Only set for AI-enhanced filters (i.e. those with an `enhancedSearchDescription`).
Present only when `matched` is `true` and an enhanced match reason exists; omitted otherwise.
matchReason.example: Product matches the vintage Art Deco style described in your search filter.

matchFeedback.description:
Optional feedback previously recorded by the authenticated user for this saved-search match.
Present only when `matched` is `true` and feedback has been explicitly stored for the match.
`true` marks the match as relevant, `false` marks it as not relevant.

amount.description: Price amount in minor currency units (e.g., cents for most supported currencies, whole yen for JPY)

ProductCreatedEventPayloadData.description: Minimal information about an product when it was created

ProductEventStateChangedPayloadData.description: Payload for state change events, containing both old and new state

ProductEventPriceChangedPayloadData.description:
Payload for price change events. Both `oldPrice` and `newPrice` are optional:
- `oldPrice` absent, `newPrice` present: price was first discovered (initial price detection)
- `oldPrice` present, `newPrice` present: price changed (dropped or increased)
- `oldPrice` present, `newPrice` absent: price was removed

oldPrice.description: The previous price. Absent when this is the first price discovery.

newPrice.description: The new price. Absent when the price is removed.

ProductEventEstimatePriceChangedPayloadD.description:
Payload for estimate price change events. Both `priceEstimateMin` and `priceEstimateMax` are optional:
only the fields that actually changed are present.

priceEstimateMin.description: The updated lower bound of the estimated price range. Absent if this field was not changed.

priceEstimateMax.description: The updated upper bound of the estimated price range. Absent if this field was not changed.

ProductEventUrlChangedPayloadData.description: Payload for URL change events, containing the new product URL.

url.description: The new URL of the product on the shop's website.

ProductEventImagesChangedPayloadData.description: Payload for image list change events, containing the complete updated image list.

images.description: The complete updated list of product images.

ProductEventAuctionTimeChangedPayloadDat.description:
Payload for auction time change events. Both `auctionStart` and `auctionEnd` are optional:
only the fields that actually changed are present.

auctionStart.description: Updated RFC3339 auction start timestamp. Absent if this field was not changed.

auctionEnd.description: Updated RFC3339 auction end timestamp. Absent if this field was not changed.

productId.description: Unique internal identifier for the product

sellerId.description: Unique identifier of the seller associated with the product event

shopsProductId.description: Shop's unique identifier for the product. Can be any arbitrary string.

LanguageData.description:
Supported language codes (ISO 639-1 canonical values):
- de: German (includes de-DE, de-AT, de-CH, de-LU, de-LI)
- en: English (includes en-US, en-GB, en-AU, en-CA, en-NZ, and backend-specific accepted alias en_IE)
- fr: French (includes fr-FR, fr-CA, fr-BE, fr-CH, fr-LU)
- es: Spanish (includes es-ES, es-MX, es-AR, es-CO, es-CL, es-PE, es-VE)
- it: Italian (includes it-IT, it-CH)
- zh: Chinese (Simplified) (includes zh-CN, zh-Hans)
- pt: Portuguese (includes pt-PT, pt-BR)
- pl: Polish (includes pl-PL)
- tr: Turkish (includes tr-TR)
- nl: Dutch (includes nl-NL, nl-BE)
- cs: Czech (includes cs-CZ)
- ja: Japanese (includes ja-JP)
- ru: Russian (includes ru-RU)
- ar: Arabic (includes ar-SA, ar-EG, ar-AE)

`de`, `en`, `fr`, `es`, and `it` are fully supported localization/translation-target languages.
`zh`, `pt`, `pl`, `tr`, `nl`, `cs`, `ja`, `ru`, and `ar` are ingestion-only languages:
they can appear in stored/native content and are accepted anywhere `LanguageData` is used,
but backend-generated translations and fallback localized strings are not produced in these languages.

CurrencyData.description:
Supported currencies (ISO 4217 codes):
- EUR: Euro
- GBP: British Pound
- USD: US Dollar
- AUD: Australian Dollar
- CAD: Canadian Dollar
- NZD: New Zealand Dollar
- CNY: Chinese Yuan
- BRL: Brazilian Real
- PLN: Polish Złoty
- TRY: Turkish Lira
- JPY: Japanese Yen
- CZK: Czech Koruna
- RUB: Russian Ruble
- AED: UAE Dirham
- SAR: Saudi Riyal
- HKD: Hong Kong Dollar
- SGD: Singapore Dollar
- CHF: Swiss Franc

ProductStateData.description:
Current state of the product:
- LISTED: Product has been listed
- AVAILABLE: Product is available for purchase
- RESERVED: Product is reserved by a buyer
- SOLD: Product has been sold
- REMOVED: Product has been removed and can no longer be tracked
- UNKNOWN: Product has an unknown state

AuctionData.description:
Auction time window information for products from auction houses.
Contains optional start and end timestamps for scheduled auctions.
At least one of the fields (start or end) must be present when this object is included.

start.description:
Start datetime of the auction window for this product (RFC3339 format).
Only present for products from auction houses with scheduled auction start times.
Used to indicate when bidding begins or when the item will be auctioned.

end.description:
End datetime of the auction window for this product (RFC3339 format).
Only present for products from auction houses with scheduled auction end times.
Used to indicate when bidding ends or when the auction session concludes.

PriceEstimateData.description:
Price estimate range for a product.
Contains optional minimum and maximum estimated prices.

min.description: Optional minimum estimated price for the product

max.description: Optional maximum estimated price for the product

PricingData.description:
Complete pricing information for a product.
Contains both the offer price and optional price estimates.

offer.description:
The actual offer or asking price for the product.
This is the price at which the product is currently being sold.

estimate.description:
Optional price estimate range.
Common for auction items where an estimated value range is provided.

ProhibitedContentData.description:
Classification of prohibited or sensitive content that may be present in product images:
- UNKNOWN: Content classification has not been determined
- NONE: No prohibited content detected in the image
- NAZI_GERMANY: Image contains Nazi Germany symbols, insignia, or related content

ShopTypeData.description:
Type of vendor or shop:
- AUCTION_HOUSE: Auction house selling items through auctions
- AUCTION_PLATFORM: Auction platform hosting auctions for auction-houses
- COMMERCIAL_DEALER: Commercial dealer or shop selling items directly
- MARKETPLACE: Marketplace platform connecting buyers and sellers

ShopPartnerStatusData.description:
Partner relationship status of a shop:
- SCRAPED: Shop data exists without a linked partner user
- PARTNERED: Shop is linked to a partner user

ProductImageData.description:
Product image with prohibited content classification.
The `url` field is omitted when the image contains prohibited content and the authenticated user has not consented to view such content.
For unauthenticated users the `url` is always omitted for any image whose `prohibitedContent` is not `NONE`.

url.description:
URL to the product image.
Absent when the image has prohibited content (`prohibitedContent != "NONE"`) and the user has not given consent (`prohibitedContent.consent == false`).

SortProductFieldData.description:
Fields available for sorting:
- score: Sort by relevance score (default, only available when searching with text query)
- price: Sort by product price
- updated: Sort by last updated timestamp
- created: Sort by creation timestamp

ProductEventTypeData.description:
Types of events that can occur for a product:
- CREATED: Product was created
- STATE_CHANGED: Product state transitioned (e.g. listed → available, available → sold)
- PRICE_CHANGED: Product price was discovered, updated, or removed
- ESTIMATE_PRICE_CHANGED: Product estimated price range was updated
- URL_CHANGED: Product URL was updated
- IMAGES_CHANGED: Product image list was updated
- AUCTION_TIME_CHANGED: Product auction start or end time was updated

ProductEventPayloadData.description:
Event-specific payload data. The structure varies depending on the event type:
- CREATED: ProductCreatedEventPayloadData (initial product state and optional price)
- STATE_CHANGED: ProductEventStateChangedPayloadData (old and new state)
- PRICE_CHANGED: ProductEventPriceChangedPayloadData (old and/or new price; see schema for semantics)
- ESTIMATE_PRICE_CHANGED: ProductEventEstimatePriceChangedPayloadData (updated min/max estimate prices)
- URL_CHANGED: ProductEventUrlChangedPayloadData (new URL)
- IMAGES_CHANGED: ProductEventImagesChangedPayloadData (new image list)
- AUCTION_TIME_CHANGED: ProductEventAuctionTimeChangedPayloadData (new auction start/end times)

title.description: HTTP status code in human-readable form

ApiErrorSource.description: Information about the source of the error

field.description: Name of the field that caused the error

sourceType.description: Type of parameter that caused the error

ProductSearchData.description: Product search configuration with query parameters and filtering options

productQuery.description: Optional text query for searching products (minimum 1 character when provided)

shopName.description:
Optional filter by exact shop names (keyword matching).
Filters products to only those from shops with names exactly matching one of the provided values.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.

excludeShopName.description:
Optional filter to exclude products from specific shop names (keyword matching).
Products from shops with names exactly matching one of the provided values will be excluded from results.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.
Empty array means no shops are excluded.

sellerName.description:
Optional filter by exact seller names (keyword matching).
Filters products to only those from sellers with names exactly matching one of the provided values.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.
Applied independently from `shopName` filters.

excludeSellerName.description:
Optional filter to exclude products from specific seller names (keyword matching).
Products from sellers with names exactly matching one of the provided values will be excluded from results.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.
Applied independently from `excludeShopName` filters.
Empty array means no sellers are excluded.

shopSlugId.description:
Optional filter by exact shop slug identifiers.
Filters products to only those whose `shopSlugId` exactly matches one of the provided kebab-case values.

excludeShopSlugId.description:
Optional filter to exclude products from specific shop slug identifiers.
Products whose `shopSlugId` exactly matches one of the provided kebab-case values are excluded from results.

sellerSlugId.description:
Optional filter by exact seller slug identifiers.
Filters products to only those whose seller slug ID exactly matches one of the provided kebab-case values.

excludeSellerSlugId.description:
Optional filter to exclude products from specific seller slug identifiers.
Products whose seller slug ID exactly matches one of the provided kebab-case values are excluded from results.

country.description:
Optional filter by one or more structured-address country codes of the selling shop.
Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

continent.description: Optional filter by one or more structured-address continents of the selling shop.

geoAddress.description:
Optional geospatial proximity filter for the selling shop's indexed coordinates.
Matches products whose indexed shop coordinates fall within the given distance of the provided point.

price.description: Optional price range filter in minor currency units for the selected/requested currency

created.description: Optional filter by product creation date range

updated.description: Optional filter by product last updated date range

auctionStart.description:
Optional filter by auction start datetime range.
Filters products by when their auction windows begin.
Only matches products that have auction start times set.

auctionEnd.description:
Optional filter by auction end datetime range.
Filters products by when their auction windows end.
Only matches products that have auction end times set.

PostUserSearchFilterData.description: Request body for creating a new search filter

name.description: User-defined name for the search filter (max 255 characters, will be truncated if longer)

enhancedSearchDescription.description:
Optional natural-language description used by the AI-enhanced search filter matching service.
When provided, a language model evaluates each matched product against this description and only
keeps products that are a true match, attaching a user-facing reason to every confirmed hit.
Whitespace is trimmed and the value is silently truncated to 1000 characters if longer.
enhancedSearchDescription.example: Golden cufflinks from the Art Deco period, preferably from French workshops

PatchUserSearchFilterData.description:
Partial search filter update data.
All fields are optional and only provided fields will be updated.
Can update the search filter name, enhanced search description, notifications preference, activation state, and/or the search filter criteria.

name.description: User-defined name for the search filter (max 255 characters, will be truncated if longer)

enhancedSearchDescription.description:
Optional natural-language description used by the AI-enhanced search filter matching service.
When provided, a language model evaluates each matched product against this description and only
keeps products that are a true match, attaching a user-facing reason to every confirmed hit.
Whitespace is trimmed and the value is silently truncated to 1000 characters if longer.
Omit to leave unchanged.
enhancedSearchDescription.example: Golden cufflinks from the Art Deco period, preferably from French workshops

notifications.description:
Whether to enable or disable email/push notifications for new products matching this search filter.
When `true`, the user will be notified when a new product matches this filter.
When `false`, no notifications are sent for this filter.
Omit to leave unchanged.

state.description:
Optional activation state update for this saved search filter.
`ACTIVE` reactivates the filter if the current user tier still permits the configured search features and quota.
`INACTIVE_BY_USER` manually disables the filter.
Omit to leave the current state unchanged.

search.description: Partial search filter criteria to update

PatchUserSearchFilterMatchData.description:
Partial update payload for a saved-search product match.
Omitting `feedback` leaves the stored match feedback unchanged.

feedback.description:
Optional relevance feedback for the matched product.
`true` marks the product as relevant to the saved search filter, `false` marks it as not relevant.

PatchProductSearchData.description:
Partial search filter criteria update.
All fields are optional and only provided fields will be updated.
Follows the same structure as ProductSearchData but with optional fields.

language.description: Language for search and localized content

productQuery.description: Text query for searching products (minimum 1 character when provided)

shopName.description:
Optional filter by exact shop names (keyword matching).

Products from shops with names exactly matching one of the provided values will be excluded from results.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.

Filters products to only those from sellers with names exactly matching one of the provided values.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.
Applied independently from `shopName` filters.

Optional filter to exclude products from specific seller names (keyword matching).
Products from sellers with names exactly matching one of the provided values will be excluded from results.
This is an exact match filter, not a fuzzy text search.

Optional filter by exact shop slug identifiers.
Filters products to only those whose `shopSlugId` exactly matches one of the provided kebab-case values.

Products whose seller slug ID exactly matches one of the provided kebab-case values are excluded from results.

country.description: Optional replacement filter by structured-address country codes of the selling shop.

continent.description: Optional replacement filter by structured-address continents of the selling shop.

geoAddress.description: Optional replacement geo-distance filter for the selling shop's indexed coordinates.

price.description: Optional price range filter in minor currency units for the selected/requested currency

created.description: Optional filter by product creation date range

updated.description: Optional filter by product last updated date range

auctionStart.description:
Optional filter by auction start datetime range.
Filters products by when their auction windows begin.
Only matches products that have auction start times set.

auctionEnd.description:
Optional filter by auction end datetime range.
Filters products by when their auction windows end.
Only matches products that have auction end times set.

UserSearchFilterData.description: Complete user search filter with metadata

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns this search filter

userSearchFilterId.description: Unique identifier for this search filter

name.description: User-defined name for the search filter

enhancedSearchDescription.description:
Optional natural-language description used by the AI-enhanced search filter matching service.
Present only when an enhanced search description was set on this filter.
enhancedSearchDescription.example: Golden cufflinks from the Art Deco period, preferably from French workshops

notifications.description:
Whether notifications are enabled for this search filter.
When `true`, the user will be notified when a new product matches this filter.
When `false`, no notifications are sent for this filter.
Defaults to `true` for newly created filters.

created.description: When the search filter was created (RFC3339 format)

updated.description: When the search filter was last updated (RFC3339 format)

ResourceStateData.description:
Activation state of a stored user-owned resource such as a saved search filter.
`ACTIVE` resources are eligible for their normal runtime behavior.
`INACTIVE_BY_USER` resources were explicitly deactivated by the user.
`INACTIVE_BY_RESTRICTED_PLAN` resources remain stored but are inactive because the user's current tier no longer allows them to stay active.

PatchResourceStateData.description:
Client-settable activation state for resources that support manual activation toggles.
Clients may reactivate a resource with `ACTIVE` or manually disable it with `INACTIVE_BY_USER`.
`INACTIVE_BY_RESTRICTED_PLAN` is managed internally by the backend and is never accepted from clients.

userSearchFilterId.description: Unique identifier of the saved search filter that matched the product.

shopId.description: Unique identifier of the shop that owns the matched product.

shopsProductId.description: Shop's own identifier for the matched product.

productId.description: Unique internal identifier of the matched product.

feedback.description:

Present only after the user has explicitly marked the match as relevant or not relevant.

created.description: When the search-filter product match was originally created (RFC3339 format).

updated.description: When the search-filter product match was last updated (RFC3339 format).

CountryCodeData.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code serialized by the backend.

ContinentData.description: Continent derived from a structured-address country code.

StructuredAddressData.description:
Structured postal address used for shop metadata and geocoding.
When supplied in shop create/update payloads, at least one component among `addressline`,
`addresslineExtra`, `locality`, `region`, `postalCode`, or `country` must contain a non-empty
value; `continent` alone does not make the address valid, and otherwise the backend rejects the
request with `400 BAD_BODY_VALUE`.

addressline.description: Primary free-form address line such as street and house number.

addresslineExtra.description: Optional secondary address line such as floor, suite, building, or c/o information.

region.description: Region, state, province, or administrative area.

country.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code serialized by the backend.
When `continent` is omitted but `country` is present, the backend derives the continent from this code.

continent.description:
Optional continent value exposed alongside `country` in structured-address data.
If omitted while `country` is present, the backend derives it automatically.

GeoAddressData.description: Latitude/longitude coordinates derived by the backend from `structuredAddress`.

shopSlugId.description:
Human-readable slug identifier of the shop (kebab-case, derived from shop name).
Example: "tech-store-premium" or "christies"

domains.description:
All known domains associated with the shop.
Domains are normalized (lowercase, no scheme, no www prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopifyDomain.description:
Optional normalized Shopify storefront domain associated with the shop.
Used by the backend to match Shopify product lifecycle events to the shop.
Normalized with the same rules as `domains` (lowercase, no scheme, no `www.` prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopifyCurrency.description: Optional Shopify currency configured for the shop, serialized as an ISO 4217 code.

shopifyLanguage.description:
Optional Shopify default language configured for the shop.
Relevant for shops using Shopify partner-shop ingestion.
When present, Shopify product lifecycle events for this shop are ingested using this language.
When absent, Shopify product lifecycle events for this shop currently fail instead of inferring or defaulting a language.

woocommerceCurrency.description:
Optional WooCommerce currency configured for webhook-ingested products, serialized as an ISO 4217 code.
When WooCommerce webhooks send a non-empty `price`, the backend parses that amount in this currency.

woocommerceLanguage.description:
Optional WooCommerce default language configured for the shop.
Relevant for shops using `POST /api/v1/webhooks/woocommerce/{shopId}`.
When present, WooCommerce webhook-ingested products for this shop are ingested using this language.
When absent, WooCommerce webhook requests for this shop currently fail instead of inferring or defaulting a language.

url.description: Optional primary URL of the shop website.

viewUrl.description:
Optional tracked or affiliate URL derived from `url` for user-facing navigation.
When the shop has a primary `url`, the backend may populate this field with either Aura Historia tracking parameters or an affiliate-link target.

image.description: Optional URL to the shop's logo or image

phone.description: Optional public contact phone number of the shop.

email.description: Optional public contact email address of the shop.

createdBy.description: Actor who created this shop record

updatedBy.description: Actor who last updated this shop record

created.description: When the shop was first created (RFC3339 format)

updated.description: When the shop was last updated (RFC3339 format)

shopNameQuery.description: Optional text query for searching shops by name

partnerStatus.description:
Optional filter by shop partner relationship status.

countries.description:
Optional repeated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country-code filter.

continents.description:

PatchShopData.description:
Partial update for a shop.
Only the fields present in the request body are applied; omitted or `null` fields are left unchanged.
All fields are optional, so `{}` is accepted as a no-op update when sent as the JSON request body.

domains.description:
Optional updated set of domains for the shop.
When provided, this replaces the existing domains entirely.
Domains are normalized (lowercase, no scheme, no www prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopifyDomain.description:
Optional updated Shopify storefront domain used for Shopify partner-shop event matching.
Normalized with the same rules as `domains`.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current Shopify domain remains unchanged.

shopifyCurrency.description:
Optional updated Shopify currency for the shop, serialized as an ISO 4217 code.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current Shopify currency remains unchanged.

shopifyLanguage.description:
Optional updated Shopify default language for the shop.
When configured, Shopify product lifecycle events for this shop are ingested using this language.
When absent on the stored shop record, Shopify product lifecycle events currently fail instead of inferring or defaulting a language.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current Shopify language remains unchanged.

woocommerceWebhookSecret.description:
Optional replacement WooCommerce webhook secret used to validate HMAC signatures on
`POST /api/v1/webhooks/woocommerce/{shopId}`.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current webhook secret remains unchanged.
This field is write-only and is never returned by read responses.

woocommerceCurrency.description:
Optional updated WooCommerce currency for the shop, serialized as an ISO 4217 code.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current WooCommerce currency remains unchanged.
This currency is used when WooCommerce webhook payloads provide a non-empty `price`.

woocommerceLanguage.description:
Optional updated WooCommerce default language for the shop.
When configured, WooCommerce webhook-ingested products for this shop are ingested using this language.
When absent on the stored shop record, WooCommerce webhook requests currently fail instead of inferring or defaulting a language.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current WooCommerce language remains unchanged.

url.description:
Optional updated primary URL of the shop website.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current URL remains unchanged.

image.description:
Optional updated URL to the shop's logo or image.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current image is left unchanged.

structuredAddress.description:
Optional updated structured postal address.
When provided with at least one non-empty component, the backend geocodes it and refreshes `geoAddress`.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current address remains unchanged.

phone.description: Optional updated public contact phone number. When omitted or set to `null`, the current phone number remains unchanged.

email.description: Optional updated public contact email address. When omitted or set to `null`, the current email address remains unchanged.

PostShopData.description:
Payload for creating a new shop.
The backend derives `shopSlugId` from `name`, stores `domains` as a unique normalized set,
and initializes the created shop with `partnerStatus` set to `SCRAPED`.

name.description: Display name of the shop. Used to derive the human-readable `shopSlugId`.

domains.description:
Unique set of domains associated with the shop.
Input values are normalized by stripping any `http://` or `https://` scheme, optional `www.` prefix,
and any port, path, query, or fragment, then lowercasing the remaining domain.

shopifyDomain.description:
Optional Shopify storefront domain associated with the shop.
Used by the backend to match Shopify product lifecycle events to the shop.
Input values are normalized with the same rules as `domains`.

shopifyCurrency.description: Optional Shopify currency associated with the shop, serialized as an ISO 4217 code.

shopifyLanguage.description:
Optional Shopify default language associated with the shop.
Relevant for shops using Shopify partner-shop ingestion.
When configured, Shopify product lifecycle events for this shop are ingested using this language.
When omitted, Shopify product lifecycle events for this shop currently fail instead of inferring or defaulting a language.

woocommerceWebhookSecret.description:
Optional WooCommerce webhook secret stored for validating HMAC signatures on
`POST /api/v1/webhooks/woocommerce/{shopId}`.
This field is write-only and is never returned by read responses.

woocommerceCurrency.description:
Optional WooCommerce currency associated with the shop, serialized as an ISO 4217 code.
This currency is used when WooCommerce webhook payloads provide a non-empty `price`.

woocommerceLanguage.description:
Optional WooCommerce default language associated with the shop.
Relevant for shops using `POST /api/v1/webhooks/woocommerce/{shopId}`.
When configured, WooCommerce webhook-ingested products for this shop are ingested using this language.
When omitted, WooCommerce webhook requests for this shop currently fail instead of inferring or defaulting a language.

url.description: Optional primary URL of the shop website.

image.description: Optional URL to the shop's logo or image.

structuredAddress.description:
Optional structured postal address.
When provided, the backend geocodes it and stores the resulting coordinates in `geoAddress`.

phone.description: Optional public contact phone number of the shop.

email.description: Optional public contact email address of the shop.

AccessTokenTypeData.description: Token type returned for Aura Historia access tokens.

accessTokenId.description: Unique identifier of the access token.

scope.description: Granted access-token scopes. Omitted when the token has no scopes.

Plaintext or masked bearer token value.

OAuthClientMetadataRequestData.description:
Request body for creating OAuth client metadata.
`redirect_uris` must contain at least one HTTPS redirect URI.

tos_uri.description: HTTPS URL of the OAuth client's terms-of-service document.

Request body for updating OAuth client metadata.
Omitted or `null` optional properties leave the stored value unchanged.

tos_uri.description: Optional replacement terms-of-service document URL for the OAuth client.

policy_uri.description: Optional replacement privacy-policy document URL for the OAuth client.

logo_uri.description: Optional replacement logo image URL for the OAuth client.

redirect_uris.description: Optional replacement set of registered HTTPS redirect URIs.

OAuthClientMetadataResponseData.description:
OAuth client metadata read model.
`client_secret` contains the plaintext secret only in the create response.
List/get/update responses return a masked secret display value instead.

client_id.description: UUIDv7 identifier of the OAuth client.

client_secret.description:
OAuth client secret.
Create responses return the plaintext secret once; later reads return a masked value such as `aurahistoria_oauth_client_secret_abcdefghijk_****`.

client_name.description: Display name of the OAuth client.

tos_uri.description: Terms-of-service document URL registered for the OAuth client.

policy_uri.description: Privacy-policy document URL registered for the OAuth client.

client_uri.description: Homepage or product-site URL registered for the OAuth client.

logo_uri.description: Logo image URL registered for the OAuth client.

redirect_uris.description: Registered redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

scope.description: Allowed scopes for tokens issued to this OAuth client.

client_id_issued_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the OAuth client was created and its client ID was issued.

OAuthTokenResponseData.description:
Token response returned by `POST /api/v1/oauth/token` and
`GET /api/v1/oauth/tokens/by-third-party-code/{thirdPartyCode}`.
The `access_token` is an Aura Historia bearer access token. `expires_in` is omitted
(`null`) for non-expiring tokens. `third_party_exchange_code` is only present on the
direct token exchange response.

access_token.description: The issued Aura Historia access token (plaintext bearer value).

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires. `null` when the token does not expire.

scope.description: Space-separated list of scopes granted to the access token.

third_party_exchange_code.description:
Optional one-time exchange code returned by `POST /api/v1/oauth/token`.
It can be redeemed once via `GET /api/v1/oauth/tokens/by-third-party-code/{thirdPartyCode}`
within 60 seconds to obtain the same access token.

OAuthIntrospectionResponseData.description:
Introspection response returned by `POST /api/v1/oauth/introspect` (RFC 7662).
When `active` is `false` all other fields are omitted.
When `active` is `true` the available token metadata is populated.

active.description: Whether the token is currently active (not expired, not revoked, and known to this server).

scope.description: Space-separated list of scopes granted to the token. Present only when `active` is `true`.

client_id.description: UUIDv7 OAuth client identifier that issued the token. Present only when `active` is `true` and the token was issued via the OAuth flow.

sub.description: Subject — the Aura Historia user ID who authorized the token. Present only when `active` is `true`.

exp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the token expires. Present only when `active` is `true` and the token has an expiry.

iat.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the token was issued. Present only when `active` is `true` and the issue time is known.

UserTierData.description:
The user's subscription tier, which determines limits and feature access (e.g. max watchlist entries, max search filters, allowed search filter fields).
- `FREE`: Default tier for all users. Allows up to 20 watchlist entries, up to 1 search filter (limited to `productQuery`, `price`, and `state` filter fields), and up to 10 product matches per filter.
- `PRO`: Premium tier. Allows up to 100 watchlist entries, up to 5 search filters with access to all filter fields, and unlimited product matches per filter.
- `ULTIMATE`: Highest tier. Allows unlimited watchlist entries, unlimited search filters with access to all filter fields, and unlimited product matches per filter.

UserRoleData.description:
The user's role used for API authorization.
- `USER`: Standard authenticated user.
- `ADMIN`: Administrator with access to admin-only endpoints.

NotificationPayloadData.description:
The notification payload. The structure depends on the `type` discriminator field:
- `WATCHLIST`: Notification triggered by a watchlist event (price change or state change).
- `SEARCH_FILTER`: Notification triggered when a new product matches a user's search filter.
- `PARTNER_APPLICATION`: Notification triggered when a partner shop application is approved or rejected.

Absent when the product had no images. The URL is always included (prohibited content filtering is skipped for notifications).

viewUrl.description: Tracked or affiliate URL generated by the backend for user-facing navigation to the product.

WatchlistPayloadData.description:
The watchlist-specific sub-payload. The structure depends on the `type` discriminator field:
- `PRICE_CHANGE`: A price change event. Both `oldPrice` and `newPrice` are optional (absent when the price was not available in the requested currency).
- `STATE_CHANGE`: A product state change event. Both `oldState` and `newState` are always present.

newPrice.description: New price in the requested currency. Absent when price is unavailable in that currency.

type.description: Discriminator field identifying this as a state-change watchlist payload.

shopSlugId.description: URL-friendly slug identifier for the shop.

productSlugId.description: URL-friendly slug identifier for the product (6-character suffix).

image.description:
The first image of the product at the time the notification was generated.
Absent when the product had no images. The URL is always included (prohibited content filtering is skipped for notifications).

url.description: Raw URL to the product on the shop's website.

viewUrl.description: Tracked or affiliate URL generated by the backend for user-facing navigation to the product.

SearchFilterPayloadData.description: Search-filter-specific sub-payload identifying which saved filter matched the product.

userSearchFilterId.description: Unique identifier of the user's search filter that matched the product.

userSearchFilterName.description: User-defined name of the search filter that matched the product.

PartnerApplicationNotificationPayloadDat.description: Notification payload for a partner shop application review update.

type.description: Discriminator field identifying this as a partner application notification.

shopName.description: Display name of the shop referenced by the partner application.

image.description:
Optional shop logo URL included with partner-application notifications when the related
application or linked existing shop has an image configured.
Absent when no shop logo URL is available.

PartnerApplicationPayloadData.description:
Partner-application-specific sub-payload. The structure depends on the `type` discriminator field:
- `APPROVED`: The partner application was approved.
- `REJECTED`: The partner application was rejected.

ApprovedPartnerApplicationPayloadData.description: Partner application payload for an approval notification.

type.description: Discriminator field identifying this as an approval payload.

partnerApplicationId.description: Unique identifier of the approved partner shop application.

RejectedPartnerApplicationPayloadData.description: Partner application payload for a rejection notification.

type.description: Discriminator field identifying this as a rejection payload.

partnerApplicationId.description: Unique identifier of the rejected partner shop application.

PatchNotificationData.description:
Patch body for updating notification fields. All fields are optional.
Only provided (non-null) fields are applied.

seen.description: Set to `true` to mark the notification as seen, `false` to mark it unseen.

NotificationCollectionData.description: Cursor-paginated collection of notifications, sorted latest-first.

size.description: Requested page size echoed back from the cursor payload; this does not necessarily equal `items.length`.

searchAfter.description:
Event ID cursor for the next page (UUID string).
Present only when more results are available.
Pass this value as the `searchAfter` query parameter to retrieve the next page.

total.description: Total number of notifications for the user. May be absent in some cases.

PostProductData.description: Data for creating a single product via the partner batch-create endpoint.

shopsProductId.description: The shop's own identifier for the product. Must be unique within the shop.

price.description: Optional asking price for the product

priceEstimateMin.description: Optional lower bound of the estimated price range

priceEstimateMax.description: Optional upper bound of the estimated price range

url.description: URL to the product on the shop's website

images.description: List of image URLs for the product. May be empty.

auctionStart.description:
RFC3339 timestamp of when the auction for this product starts.
Only relevant for auction-house shop types. Omit for non-auction products.

auctionEnd.description:
RFC3339 timestamp of when the auction for this product ends.
Only relevant for auction-house shop types. Omit for non-auction products.

sellerName.description:
Optional raw name of the secondary seller for this product.
Only applicable for `AUCTION_PLATFORM` and `MARKETPLACE` shop types.
When provided, the backend resolves the seller shop by this name and associates the product with that seller.
When omitted, or when the shop type is neither `AUCTION_PLATFORM` nor `MARKETPLACE`, the partner shop itself is used as the seller.

structuredAddress.description: Optional structured address to attach to the product for geo-aware indexing and search.

geoAddress.description: Optional coordinates to attach to the product for geo-aware indexing and search.

PartnerProductEnqueueFailuresResponse.description:
Response for the partner batch product enqueue endpoints.
Contains only the `shopsProductId` values that failed to be forwarded to the
asynchronous ingestion queue. An empty array indicates that all commands were
accepted for asynchronous processing.

items.description: A `shopsProductId` that failed to be forwarded to the queue.

PatchProductData.description:
Data for enqueuing an update for a single product via the partner batch-update endpoint.
Only `shopsProductId` is required; all other fields are optional and, when omitted,
the corresponding product attribute is left unchanged during later asynchronous ingestion.

shopsProductId.description: The shop's own identifier for the product to update. The request is accepted for asynchronous processing even though product existence is evaluated later during ingestion.

price.description: Optional updated asking price for the product. Omit to leave the current price unchanged.

state.description: Optional updated product state. Omit to leave the current state unchanged.

priceEstimateMin.description: Optional updated lower bound of the estimated price range. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

priceEstimateMax.description: Optional updated upper bound of the estimated price range. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

url.description: Optional updated URL to the product on the shop's website. Omit to leave the current URL unchanged.

images.description: Optional updated list of image URLs for the product. Omit to leave the current images unchanged.

auctionStart.description: Optional updated RFC3339 timestamp of when the auction starts. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

auctionEnd.description: Optional updated RFC3339 timestamp of when the auction ends. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

PutProductData.description:
Data for upserting a single product via the partner batch-upsert endpoint.
Only `shopsProductId` is required. All other fields are optional.

During later asynchronous ingestion:
- If the product **does not yet exist**, it is created using all provided fields.
  Omitting `title`, `url`, or `state` will result in placeholder defaults being applied
  internally (empty title, a placeholder URL, and `LISTED` state respectively).
- If the product **already exists**, `price`, `priceEstimateMin`,
  `priceEstimateMax`, `state`, `url`, `images`, `auctionStart`, and `auctionEnd`
  participate in the update path.
- On the update path, omitting or sending `null` for `price`, `priceEstimateMin`,
  `priceEstimateMax`, `url`, `auctionStart`, or `auctionEnd` leaves the stored value
  unchanged.
- On the update path, omitting `images` or sending `null` is treated as an empty list
  and therefore clears all stored images.

shopsProductId.description: The shop's own identifier for the product. Must be unique within the shop.

title.description: Optional localized title for the product. Used only when creating a new product.

description.description: Optional localized description of the product. Used only when creating a new product.

price.description: Optional asking price for the product. Applied on create and on update when a non-null value is provided. Omit or send `null` to leave the current stored price unchanged.

priceEstimateMin.description: Optional lower bound of the estimated price range. Applied on both create and update paths. Omit or send `null` to leave the current stored lower bound unchanged.

priceEstimateMax.description: Optional upper bound of the estimated price range. Applied on both create and update paths. Omit or send `null` to leave the current stored upper bound unchanged.

state.description: Optional product state. Applied on both create and update paths.

url.description: URL to the product on the shop's website. Applied on both create and update paths. Omit or send `null` to leave the current stored URL unchanged.

images.description: List of image URLs for the product. Applied on both create and update paths. On update, the provided array replaces the stored image set; omitting `images` or sending `null` is treated as an empty list and therefore clears all stored images.

auctionStart.description:
RFC3339 timestamp of when the auction for this product starts.
Only relevant for auction-house shop types. Applied on both create and update paths.
Omit or send `null` to leave the current stored start timestamp unchanged.

auctionEnd.description:
RFC3339 timestamp of when the auction for this product ends.
Only relevant for auction-house shop types. Applied on both create and update paths.
Omit or send `null` to leave the current stored end timestamp unchanged.

sellerName.description:
Optional raw name of the secondary seller for this product.
Only applicable for `AUCTION_PLATFORM` and `MARKETPLACE` shop types.
When provided, the backend resolves the seller shop by this name and associates the product with that seller.
When omitted, or when the shop type is neither `AUCTION_PLATFORM` nor `MARKETPLACE`, the partner shop itself is used as the seller.
Used only when creating a new product.

structuredAddress.description: Optional structured address to attach to the product for geo-aware indexing and search. Used only when creating a new product.

geoAddress.description: Optional coordinates to attach to the product for geo-aware indexing and search. Used only when creating a new product.

WoocommerceProductWebhookImageData.description: Image object extracted from a WooCommerce product payload.

src.description: Absolute URL of a product image.

WoocommerceProductWebhookUpsertData.description:
WooCommerce product payload accepted for `product.created` and `product.updated`.
The backend requires `id`, `name`, and `permalink` for these topics.

id.description: WooCommerce product identifier. It is converted to the internal `shopsProductId`.

permalink.description: Public URL of the WooCommerce product.

description.description: Optional HTML product description. The backend converts it to plain text for indexing.

short_description.description: Optional HTML short description used when `description` is absent.

price.description:
Optional decimal price string from WooCommerce.
The backend accepts ASCII digits with an optional fractional part, trims whitespace,
and truncates the fractional part to at most two digits before storing the amount in
the shop's configured `woocommerceCurrency`.

status.description:
Optional WooCommerce product status string.
Recognized mappings are: `publish` -> `AVAILABLE` unless `stock_status` is `outofstock`,
`draft` / `pending` / `private` -> `LISTED`, `trash` -> `REMOVED`, and any other value -> `UNKNOWN`.

stock_status.description:
Optional WooCommerce stock-status string.
When `status` is `publish`, `outofstock` maps to `SOLD`; all other values map to `AVAILABLE`.

images.description: Optional list of WooCommerce product images. Missing payload fields are treated as an empty list.

WoocommerceProductWebhookDeleteData.description:
WooCommerce product payload accepted for `product.deleted`.
Only `id` is required. If `name` or `permalink` are provided they may still be used by the backend,
but the event remains valid with just the product ID.

id.description: WooCommerce product identifier. It is converted to the internal `shopsProductId`.

PartnerShopApplicationStateData.description:
The business review state of a partner shop application:
- `SUBMITTED`: Application has been submitted and is awaiting review.
- `IN_REVIEW`: Application is currently being reviewed by the team.
- `REJECTED`: Application was reviewed and rejected.
- `APPROVED`: Application was reviewed and approved.
The state is read-only from the client perspective and can only be changed internally.

ExecutionStateData.description:
The workflow execution state of a partner shop application:
- `PROCESSING`: The backend workflow is actively processing the application.
- `WAITING`: The workflow is paused and waiting for an admin decision.
- `COMPLETED`: The workflow has finished processing the application.
This state is read-only from the client perspective and is fully managed by the backend workflow.

GetPartnerShopApplicationPayloadData.description:
The payload of a partner shop application. Discriminated by the `type` field.
- `EXISTING`: The application targets an existing shop and includes the hydrated shop data.
- `NEW`: The application targets a new shop described by name, type, domains, and optional metadata such as a primary URL, image, address, and contact details.

type.description: Discriminator value indicating this payload targets an existing shop.

shop.description: Hydrated data for the existing shop.

type.description: Discriminator value indicating this payload describes a new shop.

shopName.description: Display name of the new shop.

shopDomains.description:
Domains associated with the new shop.
Domains are normalized (lowercase, no scheme, no www prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopUrl.description: Optional primary URL of the requested new shop website.

shopImage.description: Optional URL to the new shop's logo or image.

shopPhone.description: Optional public contact phone number for the requested new shop.

shopEmail.description: Optional public contact email address for the requested new shop.

GetPartnerShopApplicationData.description: Full representation of a partner shop application.

id.description: Unique identifier of the partner shop application.

applicantUserId.description: Unique identifier of the user who submitted the partner shop application.

executionState.description: Workflow execution state of the application.

created.description: When the application was created (RFC3339 format).

updated.description: When the application was last updated (RFC3339 format).

PostPartnerShopApplicationPayloadData.description:
Request payload for creating a new partner shop application. Discriminated by the `type` field.
- `EXISTING`: Apply for partnership for an existing shop identified by `shopId`.
- `NEW`: Apply for partnership for a new shop described by name, type, domains, and optional metadata such as a primary URL, image, address, and contact details.
The created application always starts with `businessState` `SUBMITTED` and `executionState` `PROCESSING`.

type.description: Discriminator value indicating this payload targets an existing shop.

shopId.description: Unique identifier of the existing shop to apply for.

type.description: Discriminator value indicating this payload describes a new shop.

shopName.description: Display name of the new shop.

shopDomains.description:
Domains associated with the new shop.
Domains are normalized (lowercase, no scheme, no www prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopUrl.description: Optional primary URL of the requested new shop website.

shopImage.description: Optional URL to the new shop's logo or image.

shopStructuredAddress.description: Optional structured postal address for the requested new shop.

shopPhone.description: Optional public contact phone number for the requested new shop.

shopEmail.description: Optional public contact email address for the requested new shop.

PatchPartnerShopApplicationData.description:
Partial update for a partner shop application.
Only the fields present in the request body are applied; omitted fields are left unchanged.
All fields are optional.
The `businessState` and `executionState` fields are backend-managed and cannot be modified through this endpoint.
Note: These fields only apply to applications with a `NEW` payload type.
Sending patch fields for an application with `EXISTING` payload type is accepted but has no effect.

shopName.description: Updated display name of the shop.

shopDomains.description:
Updated set of domains for the shop. Replaces the existing domains entirely.
Domains are normalized (lowercase, no scheme, no www prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopUrl.description: Updated primary URL of the requested new shop website. When omitted or set to `null`, the current value remains unchanged.

shopImage.description: Updated URL to the shop's logo or image. When omitted or set to `null`, the current image remains unchanged.

shopStructuredAddress.description:
Updated structured postal address for the requested new shop.
When provided with at least one non-empty component, the address is later geocoded during shop creation.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current address remains unchanged.

shopPhone.description: Updated public contact phone number for the requested new shop. When omitted or set to `null`, the current value remains unchanged.

shopEmail.description: Updated public contact email address for the requested new shop. When omitted or set to `null`, the current value remains unchanged.

AdminPatchPartnerShopApplicationData.description:
Partial update for a partner shop application performed by an administrator.
Only the fields present in the request body are applied; omitted fields are left unchanged.
All fields are optional.
Review decisions are handled exclusively through `POST /api/v1/partner-applications/{partnerApplicationId}/decision`.

shopName.description: Updated display name of the shop.

shopDomains.description:
Updated set of domains for the shop. Replaces the existing domains entirely.
Domains are normalized (lowercase, no scheme, no www prefix, no path/query/fragment).

shopUrl.description: Updated primary URL of the requested new shop website. When omitted or set to `null`, the current value remains unchanged.

shopImage.description: Updated URL to the shop's logo or image. When omitted or set to `null`, the current image remains unchanged.

shopStructuredAddress.description:
Updated structured postal address for the requested new shop.
When provided with at least one non-empty component, the address is later geocoded during shop creation.
When omitted or set to `null`, the current address remains unchanged.

shopPhone.description: Updated public contact phone number for the requested new shop. When omitted or set to `null`, the current value remains unchanged.

shopEmail.description: Updated public contact email address for the requested new shop. When omitted or set to `null`, the current value remains unchanged.

PartnerShopApplicationDecisionData.description: Allowed admin decision values for a partner shop application review.

PostPartnerShopApplicationDecisionData.description: Request body for submitting an admin review decision for a partner shop application.
